name: Cadreita (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Cadreita (a sun on blue within a bordure of the chains of Navarre).
history: Municipal flag of Cadreita; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
